# Prompt Optimizer

> Automated prompt and few-shot optimization built from scratch: compile a prompt against a metric by searching over instructions and labeled demonstrations.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer

## Source

- [src/prompt_optimizer/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/__init__.py): Prompt Optimizer - automated prompt and few-shot optimization from scratch.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/cli.py): Command line interface for the prompt optimizer.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/data.py): A bundled intent-classification task used for demonstrations and evaluation.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/evaluation.py): An ablation that measures what each optimizer contributes.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/lm.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/lm.py): A deterministic, offline simulated language model.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/metrics.py): Evaluation metrics and dataset scoring helpers.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/optimizers.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/optimizers.py): Optimizers that compile a prompt against a metric.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/predictor.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/predictor.py): A predictor binds a prompt to the simulated language model.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the compiled prompt.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/text.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/text.py): Deterministic text utilities shared by the language model and metrics.
- [src/prompt_optimizer/types.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-optimizer/blob/main/src/prompt_optimizer/types.py): Core data types shared across the package.
